sample_plate.description: 96-well plate containing unpooled prepared NGS library DNA samples (15-30 nM in 15 uL H2O per well)

reagent_plate.description: 96-well plate holding Diluted Primer (col 1), PCR mix (col 2), NormBead (col 3), NormElute (col 4)

reservoir.description: 12-column reservoir holding AMPure (col 1), 80% EtOH (col 3), H2O (col 7), NormWash (col 8)

pcr_plate.description: 96-well PCR plate used for the normalization PCR reaction

elution_plate.description: 96-well plate used to collect the final normalized, eluted library
